note: Both sets capture the core C3/A5 crane-attachment callouts (3" STD pipe, 4-1/2x4-1/2x1/2 plate, (2) 3/4" bolts, 1-1/2" hole, 1" plate, 1/4" weld) and both make the same misread of the PL 3"x3/8"x1'-6" plate as an "angle." Set A adds the 4x3/8" cap plate, its 3/8" thickness, the 3/4" DIA HOLE TYP and 1'-4-1/4" dimension, but also invents conditions/attributes (weld 3/8" "top connection," PV post "edge distance," "total height") and a fabricated quote "T.O. STEEL 11'-4" TYP," plus heavy duplication. Set B adds the 1/2" PL TYP, 3/8" PL TYP and the C3 scale, but degrades several callouts into vague "dimension" claims (3" TYP, 2" TYP, 3/8") and an unsupported 3/8" weld; wrong counts and overall coverage come out about even.
